title: event source
description: Receives the events of the flows of this process: flow.started, flow.paused, flow.resumed, flow.stopped, source.failed, exchange.completed, exchange.handled, exchange.failed, step.completed and step.failed, or * for all. The message has the headers event.type, event.time, event.flow.id, event.flow.name and, as they apply, event.step, event.uri, event.duration and the error.* headers of an error route; its body is a JSON summary, never the payload of the exchange. A message that comes from an event source gives no exchange or step events itself.

path.description: The event type from event:<type>, or * for every type

flowId.title: Flow id
flowId.description: Only events of the flow with this id; empty: events of every flow
